title: EmoGavel: Grounding-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Multimodal Emotion Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal emotion preference learning uses pairwise comparisons to identify which open-ended emotion descriptions align more closely with human judgments. However, existing methods primarily focus on the final preference decision and provide little explicit supervision for localizing and correcting erroneous content. To address this limitation, we propose EmoGavel, a Grounding-Aware reinforcement learning framework with Verifiable rewards for multimodal Emotion preference Learning. We first introduce grounded supervised fine-tuning (Grounded SFT), which exploits controlled-error construction information to jointly learn preference prediction, error localization, repair, and missing-evidence recovery. We then optimize these verifiable outcomes with grounding-aware group relative policy optimization (GA-GRPO), combining preference-gated grounding rewards with dynamic zero-variance rescue to prioritize preference correctness and recover

translated_title: EmoGavel：基于可验证奖励的定位感知强化学习用于多模态情感偏好学习
translated_abstract: 多模态情感偏好学习通过成对比较来识别哪些开放式情感描述更符合人类判断。然而，现有方法主要关注最终的偏好决策，对于定位和纠正错误内容几乎不提供显式监督。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了EmoGavel，一个用于多模态情感偏好学习的定位感知可验证奖励强化学习框架。我们首先引入定位监督微调，利用受控错误构建信息来联合学习偏好预测、错误定位、修复和缺失证据恢复。然后，我们通过定位感知组相对策略优化来优化这些可验证的结果，将偏好门控定位奖励与动态零方差救援机制相结合，以优先保证偏好正确性并恢复。
tldr: 提出EmoGavel框架，通过将定位感知监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习相结合，在多模态情感偏好学习中实现偏好预测、错误定位、修复和缺失证据恢复的联合优化。
en_tdlr: Proposes EmoGavel, a grounding-aware reinforcement learning framework with verifiable rewards that jointly optimizes preference prediction, error localization, repair, and missing-evidence recovery for multimodal emotion preference learning.
